event.name: Halloween Doubles
event.public_description: The Halloween Doubles is a doubles tournament for First Coast APA players to come together, dress up in costumes, play something a little different, and win prizes. While the vibe is casual, the competition is real. Prepare for the wheel of torture, Fast Saratoga, and a fast-paced Chips tournament.

registration.contact_instructions: Call or text the league office.
check_in_requirements: At least one player must be on site with full entry for the team to check-in
registration.standby_policy: Begin a standby list only after field is full
registration.field_lock_policy: After registration deadline, attendance confirmation, and final skill review; later changes require LO approval.

requirements.requirement: Active on any handicapped division roster
Has at least 10 lifetime matches in either 8-Ball or 9-Ball
Has at least 6 lifetime matches in either 8-Ball or 9-Ball
Has played at least one match in the current session
In good standing with the league office
Must be invited / listed as eligible

eligibility.gender_requirement: Not applicable, open to all gender and gender combos
eligibility.skill_level_limit: Doubles Team - Maximum combined skill level 10
eligibility.team_movement_policy: Team may still play with an adjusted race

rules.baseline: Standard APA rules apply unless an approved tournament-specific rule states otherwise.

scorekeeping.selection: Do not need to be tracked
Do not need to be tracked
Do not need to be tracked
Do not need to be tracked

rules.coaching: One timeout per team per rack
rules.additional_rules: We will have the wheel of torture set up to add a little extra fun to this event. Round one will play normal to get the rules of Fast Saratoga down. Starting in round 2 teams will spin the wheel and apply any added rules to their next round.

operations.referee_status: Yes, I already have trained referees

awards.gifts: Bonus Event tee, plaques for top teams, plaques for costume contest winners
awards.public_cash_structure: Chips payout based on chip value

setup_required: Supply registration URL if online registration is used
Confirm scoring configuration, race chart or point target
Import eligible player/team registrations using APA member numbers
Confirm bracket, seeding, byes and table assignment
Configure notification channels and message templates
Review and approve payout amounts where applicable
